scope: Actual retained experimental keylock owner, held paused/muted1s once per config/lead pair; same-region and different-region restart each measured. No AudioEngine scratch transport integration, zero native, no raw fallback. Paused owner retained WASM/PCM; not terminal disposal until this pair ends.
limits: Region frequency establishes broad source-position region only; ACK cursor is exact requested original-seconds receipt, not sample-accurate audible cursor. One1s hold per27 config/lead pairs, not54 independent1s holds. Current170ms is scheduled control, not a new latency recommendation.
safety: Capture zero output plus destination gain0; fixed stereo actual zero ConstantSource; captured missing input cannot count as zero.
